title: vq fleet release report
description: Schema /3. `repo` and `project_id` moved onto each pin and the single top-level `project_id` was dropped: after the 2026-09-08 repository split the four pins resolve in three different GitLab projects, so one id can no longer describe them. vq still READS /2 reports (see LEGACY_REPORT_SCHEMAS in src/vq/fleet_release.py) because rollout-latest must be able to read its own history; this document describes what the generator emits. The pinned, evidence-carrying input to a fleet rollout. Generated by vibe-queue/scripts/make_release_report.py. The updater deploys the SHAs named here and never resolves a pin from a branch name; see docs/fleet_update_runbook.md.

generated_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp, or null when unstamped. Stamped by the caller so report generation stays reproducible.

gating_jobs.description: Mandatory component evidence, named as the job is in that pin's OWN project. The monorepo ran every gate in one pipeline so the jobs needed distinct names (test-vq, vibe-view-test); after the split each component's suite is simply `test` in its own repository. /2 reports still carry the old names and are validated against them. A green pipeline alone is never sufficient. Under the release-only CI policy (2026-07-26) every gate is proven by the single release-gate pipeline on the exact release tree, so newly generated reports pin all four components to the release commit; historical reports may still carry per-component main-pipeline pins.

all_pins_accepted.description: True iff every pin carries acceptable evidence. False means DO NOT DEPLOY; the generator also exits non-zero.

sha40.description: Full 40-hex commit SHA. Abbreviated SHAs are never acceptable as a pin.

acceptanceRule.description: A = exact-SHA build-test green. B = tree-identical to a build-test-green commit. B-prime = differs from a build-test-green ancestor only in CHANGELOG.md, docs/**, and the pyproject.toml version line. C = no evidence; not deployable.

pipeline_status.description: Recorded for diagnosis only. Acceptance is component-specific and depends on gating_job_status; another job may fail or a superseding commit may cancel the aggregate pipeline after this gate passed.

sha.description: The SHA the pipeline actually ran on. Equals the pin's SHA under rule A; differs under B / B-prime.

repo.description: Repository this pin resolves in, e.g. "mpei/vibe-qc". Recorded for humans; project_id is what callers query.

project_id.description: GitLab numeric project id for this pin. Path-based lookups 404 on this instance, so the id is mandatory. Must match PIN_SOURCES: a pin naming the wrong project sends the evidence lookup to a repository where the SHA either does not exist or names an unrelated commit.

version.description: Module version at this exact pin.

ref_resolved_from.description: The ref this SHA was resolved from, recorded for provenance only. The ref moves; the SHA is the pin.

remediation.description: Present iff accepted is false: the exact command sequence that produces acceptable evidence.

deploy_flags.description: Copy-paste argv tail for `vq admin update`.

tag_object.description: SHA of the annotated tag object itself. Never deploy this: it is not a commit. The pin is `sha`, the peeled commit.
